landingFormalSummary: Urubuga rwizewe rufasha urubyiruko rwo mu Rwanda kubona amakuru asobanutse, ibikoresho bifatika n'inzira zo kugera ku buvuzi bwizewe.
landingHeadline: Nsobanuza ifasha urubyiruko kubona amakuru y'ubuzima yizewe, ibikoresho bifasha n'inzira itekanye yo kugera ku bufasha.
landingBody: Nsobanuza ihuriza hamwe inyigisho z'ubuzima, ubufasha bwa digital, gukurikirana imihango, kubona abahanga bemejwe n'ibikoresho byagenewe urubyiruko mu buryo bumwe bworoshye kandi bwiyubashye.
landingBriefBody: Nsobanuza ni umuryango wa mbere umuntu yifashisha ashaka ubufasha ku buzima bw'urubyiruko. Ifasha kwiga, kubaza, gukurikirana no kubona aho wajya mu buryo bumwe busobanutse.
landingHighlightOneBody: Urubuga rusobanura ubuzima bw'imyororokere, ubuzima bwo mu mutwe, imibanire n'ubuzima bw'imihango mu magambo yoroshye kumva no gukoresha.
landingHighlightTwoBody: Nsobanuza itanga ubufasha bwa digital binyuze mu kiganiro, amakuru y'inyigisho n'ibikoresho byo gukurikirana umuntu ku giti cye.
landingHighlightThreeBody: Abakoresha bashobora kuva ku makuru bakagera ku gikorwa cyo kubona abatanga serivisi bemejwe no kwitegura kuganira n'umuhanga.
landingPhotoOneAlt: Umukobwa w'umwirabura ukoresha telefone ashaka ubufasha bw'ubuzima bwa digital
landingPhotoOneCaption: Ubufasha bwa digital bugera ku rubyiruko aho rusanzwe ruri.
landingPhotoTwoCaption: Amakuru y'ubuzima akwiye kuba ya muntu, yubashye kandi yegereye abantu.
landingPhotoThreeAlt: Umuhanga w'umukobwa w'umwirabura utanga ubufasha bwitondewe
landingPhotoThreeCaption: Nsobanuza ihuza amakuru yizewe n'ubufasha nyabwo butangwa n'abantu.
landingServicesTitle: Incamake ngufi kandi itomoye ya serivisi za Nsobanuza
landingServicesBody: Buri serivisi ifasha icyiciro gitandukanye cy'urugendo rw'ukoresha, kuva ku kumenya amakuru kugera ku kwiyitaho no kugera ku buvuzi.
landingServiceEducationBody: Inkuru zubatse neza zifasha abakoresha gusobanukirwa ingingo z'ingenzi z'ubuzima.
landingServiceChatBody: Umufasha wa AI asubiza ibibazo bisanzwe kandi afasha umuntu kubona intambwe ikurikira itekanye.
landingServiceTrackingBody: Ibikoresho byo kwandika no guteganya imihango bifasha kumenya amateka yayo no kwitegura neza.
landingServiceProvidersBody: Abakoresha bashobora kubona abahanga b'ubuzima baboneka no gusaba ubufasha.
landingServiceVideosBody: Video zoroshya gusobanukirwa ku bakunda ibisobanuro biboneka n'amasomo agenda intambwe ku yindi.
landingServiceCommunityBody: Nsobanuza ihuza inyigisho, ubujyanama n'iyoherezwa mu buryo bumwe kugira ngo umuntu adashakisha serivisi zitandukanye ahantu henshi.
landingJourneyTitle: Inzira yoroshye iva ku kibazo igera ku gikorwa
landingJourneyOneBody: Umukoresha atangirira ku kibazo cyangwa ku cyo akeneye, agahita abona amakuru asobanutse atabanje kumenya neza sisiteme y'ubuzima.
landingJourneyTwoBody: Urubuga rutanga ibikoresho bihuye n'ibikenewe nk'ikiganiro, video cyangwa gukurikirana umuntu ku giti cye.
landingJourneyThreeBody: Iyo hakenewe ubufasha bwinshi, Nsobanuza ifasha kubona abatanga serivisi bemejwe no gutegura intambwe ikurikira.
landingValuesBody: Nsobanuza igamije kugira intego itomoye, ubunararibonye bwiza ku mukoresha n'ubufasha bufatika mu gufata icyemezo gishingiye ku makuru.
landingValuePrivacyBody: Uburyo urubuga rwubatswe bugabanya ipfunwe kandi bugafasha umuntu gushaka amakuru ku ngingo zoroheje kubaza.
landingValueClarityBody: Amakuru atangwa mu buryo butaziguye kandi bushyigikira kugira ngo yumvwe n'urubyiruko rwinshi.
landingValueTrustBody: Nsobanuza ntigarukira ku makuru gusa. Ifasha no kugera ku bahanga bizewe no gufata ibyemezo bifite inshingano.
landingAudienceBody: Urubuga ni ingenzi ku rubyiruko rushaka ubujyanama, ku bahanga bashaka gufasha neza, no ku bafatanyabikorwa bakeneye umurongo wa digital usobanutse wo kugera ku rubyiruko.
landingClosingTitle: Inzira isobanutse kandi ishyigikira yo kubona amakuru n'ubufasha ku buzima bw'urubyiruko
landingClosingBody: Yaba umuntu ashaka ibisubizo, agerageza gusobanukirwa ikibazo cy'ubuzima, akurikirana imihango cyangwa yitegura kuganira n'umuhanga, Nsobanuza itanga aho yatangirira hizewe kandi horoshye.
